profile.headline: Software Engineer at Ultimate Software
profile.summary: Software Engineer and father. Creator of the iOS app "Panels"

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
As a Tech Lead, I'm now responsible for the coaching/mentoring of members of 2 Scrum Teams. My responsibilities also include identifying bottlenecks in the development process/cultures that prevent the team from being effective and addressing them. I work closely with product to groom requirements and get them ready for Scrum Teams to be able to consume. 

In this role, I spend about 50% of my time writing code and 50% of my time doing managerial tasks with my direct reports.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Medrio, I was initially responsible for working with product and design to implement user stories to specification. I worked in a primarily Microsoft tech stack, including MVC, Web API, and Angular/Typescript. 

I eventually moved on to lead a scrum team of 3 other developers. I was in charge of architectural/technical reviews for the projects my scrum team was working on, as well as assisting in the implementation of stories.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Travana, I was primarily responsible for working on an internal tool used by Travel Agents to handle flight booking information, updates, and cancellations. This role required integrations to many 3rd party flight system, as well as user interface design and implementation.

This was implemented primarily with .NET technologies (MVC, Web API, Angular/Typescript)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a senior software engineer, I've taken a major role in architecting, designing, and implementing MorfMedia's Learning Management System. As a full stack developer, I've worked on implementing

The Front End: Angular, Typescript/Javascript, HTML,
Service Layer: C# .Net Web API
and Persistence: MySQL

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: At Michell Consulting Group, I work primarily as an SAP Business One Add-On Developer. Working closely with clients, I write programs that integrate their existing business processes with SAP. I also regularly modify the SAP user interface to expand functionality for our clients.

positions.title: Software Developer (Intern / Temp)
positions.description:
I began my internship with Ultimate Software, an HR/Payroll software company, working in the "Architecture and Refactoring" team. I worked primarily on Ultimate Software's mobile website. Using multiple Javascript and CSS libraries, I helped implement their mobile offering. 

I then began work in their Customs department, where I worked with clients to customize their product to fit their companies needs. This required UI changes (HTML/Javascript) as well as back end changes (C# and SQL).
